findings.detail: The auto launcher treats only zero or one visible GPU as single-GPU; with two or three visible GPUs it proceeds to launch four torchrun ranks (the fixed nproc at lines 453-460). This can make the advertised real trainer entry point fail on a valid multi-GPU host whose visible-device count is less than four. The export indexing logic itself preserves row i as item_id i (lines 1538-1559), but this launcher branch prevents integration from being reliable across supported device counts.
findings.reproduction: Run the entry point with CUDA available and torch.cuda.device_count() == 2 or 3, without GENREC_SINGLE_GPU and without RANK. resolve_single_gpu() returns false, and _launch_via_torchrun launches --nproc_per_node=4; ranks will request unavailable local devices.
findings.correction: Choose single-GPU mode whenever fewer than the configured nproc GPUs are visible, or set nproc_per_node to the detected visible device count (and preserve the selected CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES list).
